info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Payment Review Submission API
info.description: The Payment Review Submission API allows businesses to submit reviews related to payment initiation services. This endpoint serves financial institutions and service providers who wish to gather user feedback to improve service quality. By posting a review, users can share their experiences, helping organizations enhance their offerings. Typical consumers of this API include customer service teams and product managers aiming to analyze user satisfaction and implement improvements based on the feedback received.

post.summary: Initiate a review for payment PAY-300045.
